The study of epidemiological systems has generated deep interest in exploring the dynamical complexity of common infectious diseases driven by seasonally varying contact rates.

arxiv-2109-04962.title: Polynomial scaling enhancement in ground-state preparation of Ising spin models via counter-diabatic driving
arxiv-2109-04962.creator: Andreas Hartmann, Glen Bigan Mbeng, Wolfgang Lechner
arxiv-2109-04962.description: Abstract The preparation of ground states of spin systems is a fundamental operation in quantum computing and serves as the basis of adiabatic quantum computing. This form of quantum computation is subject to the adiabatic theorem which in turn poses a fundamental speed limit.

arxiv-2111-05214.title: A Topological Data Analysis Based Classifier
arxiv-2111-05214.creator: Rolando Kindelan, José Frías, Mauricio Cerda, Nancy Hitschfeld
arxiv-2111-05214.description: Abstract Topological Data Analysis is an emergent field that aims to discover the underlying dataset’s topological information. Topological Data Analysis tools have been commonly used to create filters and topological descriptors to improve Machine Learning (ML) methods. This paper proposes a different Topological Data Analysis pipeline to classify balanced and imbalanced multi-class datasets without additional ML methods.

arxiv-2204-03280.creator: N. Tzvetkov and N. Visciglia
arxiv-2204-03280.description: Abstract . Using an approach introduced by Hairer-Labbé we construct a unique global dynamics for the NLS on 𝕋 2 \mathbb{T}^{2} with a white noise potential and an arbitrary polynomial nonlinearity. We build the solutions as a limit of classical solutions (up to a phase shift) of the same equation with smoothed potentials.

arxiv-2205-04521.title: Implicit Particle Filtering via a Bank of Nonlinear Kalman Filters
arxiv-2205-04521.creator: Iman Askari, Mulugeta A. Haile, Xuemin Tu, Huazhen Fang
arxiv-2205-04521.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Iman Askari, Mulugeta A. Haile, Xuemin Tu, Huazhen Fang. The implicit particle filter seeks to mitigate particle degeneracy by identifying particles in the target distribution’s high-probability regions. This study is motivated by the need to enhance computational tractability in implementing this approach. We investigate the connection of the particle update step in the implicit particle filter with that of the Kalman filter and then formulate a novel realization of the implicit particle filter based on a bank of nonlinear Kalman filters.

arxiv-2209-02776.title: Celestial amplitude for 2d theory
arxiv-2209-02776.creator: Sarthak Duary
arxiv-2209-02776.description: Abstract We explore celestial amplitude corresponding to 2 ​ d 2d bulk 𝒮 \mathcal{S} -matrix. We consider scalar particles with identical mass and show that the celestial amplitude becomes the fourier transform of the 2 ​ d 2d 𝒮 \mathcal{S} -matrix written in the rapidity variable. We translate the crossing and unitarity conditions into the conditions on the celestial amplitude.

arxiv-2407-04868.description: Abstract Language Models (LMs) have shown their application for tasks pertinent to code and several code LMs have been proposed recently. The majority of the studies in this direction only focus on the improvements in performance of the LMs on different benchmarks, whereas LMs are considered black boxes.

arxiv-2410-04903.title: On minimizing the Wiener index of unicyclic graphs with fixed girth and given degree sequence
arxiv-2410-04903.description: Abstract . The Wiener index of a graph is the sum of all the distances between any pair of vertices. We aim to describe graphs which minimize the Wiener index among all unicyclic graphs with fixed girth and given degree sequence.

arxiv-2506-01139.title: VO 2 oscillator circuits optimized for ultrafast, 100 MHz-range operation
arxiv-2506-01139.creator: Zsigmond Pollner, Tímea Nóra Török, László Pósa, Miklós Csontos, Sebastian Werner Schmid, Zoltán Balogh, András Bükkfejes, Heungsoo Kim, Alberto Piqué, Jeurg Leuthold, János Volk, András Halbritter
arxiv-2506-01139.description: Abstract Oscillating neural networks are promising candidates for a new computational paradigm, where complex optimization problems are solved by physics itself through the synchronization of coupled oscillating circuits. Nanoscale VO 2 Mott memristors are particularly promising building blocks for such oscillating neural networks.

arxiv-2507-01039.title: On-Policy Optimization of ANFIS Policies Using Proximal Policy Optimization
arxiv-2507-01039.creator: Kaaustaaub Shankar, Wilhelm Louw, Kelly Cohen
arxiv-2507-01039.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kaaustaaub Shankar, Wilhelm Louw, Kelly Cohen. We present a reinforcement learning method for training neuro-fuzzy controllers using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). Unlike prior approaches that used Deep Q-Networks (DQN) with Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference Systems (ANFIS), our PPO-based framework leverages a stable on-policy actor-critic setup. Evaluated on the CartPole-v1 environment across multiple seeds, PPO-trained fuzzy agents consistently achieved the maximum return of 500 500 with zero variance after 20,000 20{,}000 updates, outperforming ANFIS-DQN baselines in both stability and convergence speed.

Here, we report that coiled-coil glutamate-rich protein 1 (CCER1), a germline-specific and intrinsically disordered protein (IDP), mediates postmeiotic spermatid differentiation. In contrast, CCER1 deficiency results in defective sperm chromatin compaction and infertility in mice.

pmc-11352697.description: Electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) is considered one of the most effective treatments for psychiatric disorders. ECT has proven effective in the treatment of depression, mania, catatonia and psychosis. It is presumed that seizures induced during ECT administration cause toxicity and potentially neuronal and glial cell death.

pmc-11615729.title: Endoscopic Robotic Mitral Operating Room as a Microsystem for Safety and Sustainability
pmc-11615729.creator: Douglas A Murphy, Sergey Psarev, Amalia A Jonnson, Michael E Halkos
pmc-11615729.description: Objective:Safety and sustainability are key elements of a robotic mitral valve (MV) program at any stage of development. Challenges include the positioning of the surgeon at the robotic console, increasing patient complexity, and upstream administrative staffing difficulties. We instituted a systems approach to maximize patient safety and maintain robotic service viability.

pmc-11772299.title: Ultra-small curcumin-ruthenium coordination polymer nanodots prevent renal ischemia-reperfusion injury and the progression to chronic kidney disease
pmc-11772299.creator: Xian Liu, Qin Yu, Hai-Bo Mao, Jing-Bo Hu, Wei-Hua Liu
pmc-11772299.description: Renal ischemia-reperfusion (IR) induces tissue hypoxia, resulting in disrupted energy metabolism and heightened oxidative stress. These factors contribute to tubular cell damage, which is a leading cause of acute kidney injury (AKI) and can progress to chronic kidney disease (CKD). The excessive generation of reactive oxygen species (ROS) plays a crucial role in the pathogenesis of AKI.

pmc-12729362.title: Beyond VI-RADS Uncertainty: Leveraging Spatiotemporal DCE-MRI to Predict Bladder Cancer Muscle Invasion
pmc-12729362.creator: Minghui Song, Haonan Ren, Lijuan Wang, Yihang Zhou, Xing Tang, Huanjun Wang, Yan Guo, Yang Liu, Hongbing Lu, Xiaopan Xu
pmc-12729362.description: Background: The Vesical Imaging-Reporting and Data System (VI-RADS) has limited diagnostic accuracy in distinguishing non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC) within VI-RADS categories 2 and 3, despite its value for overall NMIBC assessment. Dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI (DCE-MRI), which reflects tumor vascularity, holds promise for improving these challenging cases but remains underutilized due to unexploited spatiotemporal information.

pmc-12990272.title: Genetic and clinical determinants of tacrolimus accumulation in early liver transplantation: evidence for a combined genotype-antibiotic effect
pmc-12990272.creator: Jinlin Guo, Shiying Feng, Zifan Feng, Jinyan Yang, Xinfeng Cai, Xingang Li, Rui Zhang
pmc-12990272.description: BackgroundTacrolimus is a first-line immunosuppressant essential for preventing graft rejection after liver transplantation, but its narrow therapeutic index and extensive interindividual pharmacokinetic variability complicate optimal dosing during the early postoperative phase.MethodsThe pharmacokinetics of tacrolimus were analyzed in liver transplant recipients from longitudinal trough concentrations collected within the first 30 days of administration using non-compartmental models.

pmc-13230999.title: Gendered Language in Letters of Recommendation for Interventional Pulmonology Fellowship Candidates
pmc-13230999.creator: Matthew Glick, Erin BeDiasi, Christine Argento, Jason Akulian, Laura Frye
pmc-13230999.description: Background: Sex-based disparities persist in procedural subspecialties, including interventional pulmonology (IP). Letters of recommendation (LORs) are critical in fellowship applications, and prior research suggests sex-based bias in LORs for female candidates. Objective: To evaluate gendered language and structural differences in LORs for IP fellowship candidates by applicant and letter writer sex.
